correct_completion: I would travel around the world.
full_sentence: If I won the lottery, I would travel around the world.
acceptable_variants: I would buy a big house.

options.text: I will buy a new car tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' belongs to the first conditional, which describes real future possibilities. A second conditional imagined situation needs 'would' in the result clause.

options.text: I traveled around the world yesterday.
options.why_wrong: This is a past simple statement about a completed event. It does not express the result of an imagined condition.

options.text: I would travel around the world.
I have bought a new car.
options.why_wrong: The present perfect describes a finished action linked to the present. It does not fit an imagined situation introduced by 'if'.

grammar_focus: Second conditional: imagined or unreal situations
explanation: Second conditional sentences describe unreal or imagined situations in the present or future. The if-clause uses the past simple, and the result clause uses 'would' followed by the base verb.
translation: Si ganara la lotería, viajaría por todo el mundo.
